_spec: The resolution spec, as data. Canonical prose: 'The resolution spec' in domain/thresholds.py's module docstring. Effective value for `section`, first hit wins, each table consulted exact then parent-inherited (' > '): (1) client override, (2) client preset bundle, (3) server active snapshot, (4) snapshot 0 = the shipped default profile, (5) family derivation, (6) base. Implemented by domain/thresholds.py's resolve() and js/threshold-logic.js's resolveThreshold(); BOTH test suites iterate this file and must agree on every case — that agreement is the whole reason the file exists (the frontend once fell back to $50 and dubis low-stock to 0). null for a table means 'the caller has none' (absent server profile, older server). Derivation cases name real family categories so the family tables (generated, identical on both sides) are what answer.

cases.name: client override wins over every other table
client override absent, so the server snapshot wins
server has no value for the category, so snapshot 0 answers
neither server table names it, so derivation answers
neither table and no family, so the base answers
the client's preset bundle outranks the server snapshot
cases._why: The preset is the window's own choice; the snapshot is the machine's. Closer statement of what this window means to show wins — pinned here so the two languages cannot disagree about the one seam the prose spec left for a fixture to close.

cases.name: the server snapshot inherits its parent entry for a child
a parent entry in the server table outranks an exact default
cases._why: Table order dominates within a lookup round: the server spoke about the family, so nothing shipped should overrule it for a child — the same principle by which a parent override outranks a child default.

cases.name: $0 in the server snapshot is a value, not an absence
no server profile at all (an older server) resolves as before
the base is the caller's, not the build's
a base-by-decision category keeps the base despite its family prefix
cases._why: The server snapshot layer must not disturb derivation's respect for BASE_BY_DECISION: 'Passives - Inductors' starts with a passives family prefix and the hand-tuned era left it at the base on purpose.
